tts: This is a small, complete program: two functions do the work, and a loop runs them for three patients.
The comment names the program.
def creates the bmi function: weight divided by height squared. Python remembers it for later.
def creates the category function, which returns a word for the number. Nothing runs yet.
The loop starts with the first weight, fifty kilograms.
bmi is called with fifty and one point seven. It returns about seventeen point three.
In the category function, seventeen point three is less than eighteen point five, so it returns Underweight, and the function ends there.
print puts it all together, with one decimal place.
Next, sixty-eight kilograms: BMI twenty-three point five. It is not under eighteen point five, but it is under twenty-five, so: Normal.
Last, ninety kilograms: BMI thirty-one point one. None of the three conditions is True, so the last return gives Obese.
